page.notes: The woodcut initial Q shows a standing female figure with a column; the label RHETORICA sits under it. The heading block is set in mixed type sizes. Show-through and a Google watermark at the lower right are not transcribed. Ornaments and small marks beside "Maκαρίτη" (Greek word, printed in Greek letters) are rendered approximately; the Greek is printed in small italic type. Some characters in the lower lines are damaged and may be inexact.
